scenes.summary: You encounter Watchguard Zuo Guyan at Sky King Flats. He has been charged to investigate several faulty sky poles and is looking for some leads.

lines.text: Zuo Guyan?
REPORTING FOR DUTY...! Ah, it's you, Endmin... You almost scared me...
Ahem. Sorry about that, Endmin. I didn't notice you as I was looking for something.
According to the prologue of "Burdenbeast's Travels", constant vigilance is required in every task. Actual practice, however, proves rather difficult.
What are you looking for?
Some clues. Strange things have happened here lately. Tianshi Yan Ning thus assigned an investigation to me.
The local environment is quite overgrown. I haven't found anything yet.
Well, it's a long story.
Simply put, I believe we have discovered an unprecedented form of Blight disaster.
Stockade residents? No, of course not. It's got nothing to do with them.
After all, this incident may be linked to the Blight disaster.
The Blight?
Indeed. A few days ago, the sky pole management system reported several faults.
But when I arrived at the site with a few fellow watchguards, none of us could find anything.
Can the reports be some kind of false alarm?
That was our initial idea. But this batch of sky poles is the latest iteration we just received from the Yinglung Special Task Force.
Such advanced sky poles never malfunctioned in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone. Why would they send us error reports and faulty data here? This place should be a lot safer.
The Tianshi also ran multiple diagnostics. None of the sky poles are actually broken.
Ugh. If only I could bring a Chubby Lung to life.
The "Random Essays on Wuling" described a living Chubby Lung as a meticulous investigator who found clues that the watchguards missed and solved numerous mysteries...
Chubby Lung? This topic shift is pretty drastic. So why Chubby Lungs...?
Alright. Let's try bring the Chubby Lungs to life.
Oh? Really?

options: What is it? Anything to do with the Stockade residents?

r: What is it? Anything to do with the Stockade residents?

scenes.summary: Zuo Guyan is surprised to see that the improved drone looks like a Chubby Lung. You explain to him that the Xiranite Chubby Lung comes with Blight detection feature as you prepare the AIC Factory for mass production.

lines.text: Endmin, I just saw a Chubby Lung scampering across the place... I'm not hallucinating, right?
WH-WHAT?! Endmin, did you see it too?
The Chubby Lung did come to life... The wishing prayer described in "Super Talos" actually works!
But I also made another wish back then, will it...
Super ... Talos?
So I'm seeing things... I might have pulled too many all-nighters.
In "The Last Manglerbeast", the last mangler saw its long-dead best friend during its final moments. Perhaps I'm...
Man, calm down... And I bet your best friend isn't a Chubby Lung.
Who me?
It's actually the recon drone I told you about. I made it look like a Chubby Lung.
Is that it...? Okay.
Why do you sound so disappointed?
Disappointed?! NO WAY! The Endmin is working hard to make Wuling a better place! I'll never be disappointed!
I'm going off-topic. So is it a prototype of our recon drone? Can we start mass producing it, Endmin?
Yeah. I actually fitted a detection module for data collection within the Chubby Lung.
When the Chubby Lung approaches an actual hazard, its onboard reserve of Xiranite will be quickly depleted. This will then activate the detection module.
Sounds ... so clever! Scroll three from "Wisdom of the Wilds" said the same thing. The simpler the logic, the more watertight it is.
I'll take the Xiranite Chubby Lung and let it scamper around the site. Please help make more of them, Endmin. I gotta tell Tianshi Yan Ning this great news!
I was just a little surprised. That drone ran around while playing the sprinkler truck music...

options: That was Chen. She dressed up as a Chubby Lung.

r: That was Chen. She dressed up as a Chubby Lung.

scenes.summary: After you learn why Chen Qianyu came to this place, Zuo Guyan tells you that he is going to leave. He does not understand your plans but his investigations must continue. You propose to develop and produce a recon device that can aid his duties.

lines.text: Wow, Endmin?
Chen, why are you here?
I'm here to visit Tangtang. I saw the kid with the Chubby Lung Balloon and decided to talk to him a bit.
Endmin, I heard you talking about Chubby Lungs. Did they release a new design or something?
Is that so...? Okay. Let me help!
Endmin, the hour grows late. I must continue my search for leads.
Really? Thank you so much, Endmin! But investigations can be very tiring. Maybe I should take care of it on my own.
You don't have to do it alone. I'm planning to make a recon device for detecting Blight disasters.
A recon device that detects Blight disasters? That'd be amazing, Endmin.
Although I do not understand what you mean by bringing the Chubby Lungs to life, I still thank you for sharing the idea with me.
Let Chen and I help you too. The Blight is no laughing matter. We must get it fixed ASAP.
Oh yeah, speaking about recon devices... I actually have blueprints for a watchguard recon auto-drone. I don't know if you can use them!
